episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on optimizing YouTube titles and thumbnails to increase video views. She emphasizes the importance of creating curiosity-driven titles and visually compelling thumbnails. Sarah also discusses the use of AI tools for content creation and the benefits of outsourcing design tasks to specialists.
